steps.h: Your ChatGPT page, written for you
steps.p: Answer a short form and we write your whole directory page: description, services, service area, hours and 30 to 50 real customer questions with answers. You also get the fix plan, with every list ChatGPT reads for your trade and town and how to get on each one.

On a 20-minute call we walk you through claiming your page and the ID check, which needs your own ID. Then we fill in every field, apply you to every free list ChatGPT cites for your trade and town, make your phone, hours and services match everywhere, and ask ChatGPT again so you can see the change.

steps.h: We keep you in the answer
steps.p: Every month we ask ChatGPT again and send you the report. We keep your page and answers current, apply to new lists as they open, and fix anything ChatGPT gets wrong about you.

ladder.h: Getting named is step one. Answering first wins the job.
